title: Minimum Due trap
review: FACTS (Kiro check 18 Nov): scene 6 says paying Rs 5,000/month on Rs 50,000 at 42% grows to Rs 1,02,000 in 12 months - false (the balance falls; even with no payment it is ~Rs 76,000)
FACTS: scene 5 'principal kam hi nahi hua' false; scene 8 'RBI ke hisaab se minimum due 5%' - RBI does not set it, banks do; 5% of 50,000 is 2,500 not 5,000
removed_why: wrong maths; remade with the numbers check
